## Description

"A speaker system designed for two channel stereo playback.Two 12.7cm cone type woofers with ceramic coated cone are installed in the lower range.In addition, a 2.5cm inverted dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.Symbol-II is designed to produce a uniform radiation pattern in the audio band, keeping in mind that the radiation pattern is an important determinant of sound stage reproducibility.In addition, with a unique port design, one port is placed on the bottom and one port is placed for the rear high-frequency band to obtain a soft and glossy sound quality."
